environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No GPU available (CPU inference only). No physical camera or LetsView window available for live testing. Windows-specific packages (pygetwindow, winsdk/winrt) cannot be functionally tested on this Linux sandbox but imports must be guarded. The best.pt weights file exists for model loading tests.
contribution_requirements: Branch: feature/crack-detection-webapp. All existing tests must continue to pass. Keep the existing architecture (separate modules for detector, inference_core, capture_manager, etc).
key_patterns: VideoSource/LetsViewSource provide open/read/release/is_open interface. Detector runs background thread calling annotate_frame() and passing frames to CaptureManager. CaptureManager is a state machine (monitoring->threshold_reached->capturing->analyzing->analysis_complete->cooldown). Flask routes only read from Detector. Frontend polls /status, /capture/status, /api/summary. Templates use Jinja2. CSS uses custom properties in :root.
directory_structure: Root: all Python modules at top level. templates/ has dashboard.html and inspections.html. static/ has style.css, js/dashboard.js, sounds/alert.wav, img/*.svg. tests/ has test_integration.py. captures/ directory for saved inspections (images/, overlays/, metadata/, reports/, exports/).
